statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
Cardiac event monitoring is indicated to capture the rhythm during intermittent symptomatic events
The clinical indication note documents that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate
The claim was denied with denial reason code CO-97
The diagnosis codes are I47.1, I48.0, R00.2
